Hi all — I investigated the subledger and ledger runs from Nov 3. It looks like a migration job that re-ingested October adjustments ran twice during a backfill. The duplicate ingestion produced a negative adjustment row that was exported to the invoice CSV and picked up by the PDF generator. I attached a truncated subledger_run_20261103.csv showing the duplicate adjustment IDs for our internal audit.

Proposed remediation steps:
1) Issue a formal credit memo for the duplicated amount ($12,480) referencing invoice INV-202610-BW and include BrightWave's VAT ID. The credit memo should show the tax breakdown with VAT explicitly reversed where required.
2) Generate an adjustment reversing the duplicate ledger entry so our GL matches the credit memo and post a correcting journal entry (we'll route to accounting for Nov 5 posting).
3) Update the invoice export process so refunds/adjustments with the same source_id are deduplicated in the billing export (task FIN-3121).

Questions for BrightWave:
- Confirm VAT treatment: do you want the credit memo to be VAT-credited (i.e., show VAT reversal) or a net zero VAT line with reverse-charge commentary?
- Any specific reference number you require on our credit memo for your AP ticketing?

I can prepare the draft credit memo today; Marissa can publish once you confirm the VAT line. Sean, please keep Collections aware of the hold and patch AR aging if needed.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
